function.name: history_api_get_president_by_year
function.description: Get the name of the U.S. President for a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The year you want to know the U.S. president of.

full_term_only.description: Flag to determine if we should only return presidents that served a full term for the specified year.

message.reasoning:
User asks "1940年的美国总统是谁?" They likely expect answer: Franklin D. Roosevelt (FDR). But they might also ask about who was president during entire year? In 1940, FDR was still serving his third term; he had been elected in 1932 and re-elected in 1936 and again in 1940 but not yet inaugurated until March 1941. Actually US presidential terms start on Jan 20th after election. So in 1940 calendar year, from January 1st to December 31st, there were two presidents: Herbert Hoover until Jan 20, then FDR starting Jan 20. Wait check: Hoover's last day was Jan 20, 1945? No that's wrong. Let's recall: Hoover served 1929–1933. He left office on Jan 20, 1933. Then FDR took over. So in 1940, all days were under FDR because he started in 1933. Yes correct.

Thus answer: Franklin Delano Roosevelt.

But user asked Chinese question. Provide answer in Chinese. Also maybe use tool to confirm via API. Use function call with year=1940. Probably no need for full_term_only flag. We'll just get result.
